verdict.rationale: The inspection half is supported. A hands-on user reports that n8n keeps all historical executions with per-node input/output data, and the pricing page lists 'Execution search'. Nothing in the pack shows re-running a failed execution, and certainly not resuming from the failing step; error workflows (docs-5) only control how n8n responds to a failure, which is a different feature. Missing for 10: documented retry/re-run of failed executions, resume-from-failing-step behavior, first-party docs on the execution log view.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step

citations.quote: It keeps all the historical executions so you can see what happened when workflows failed and what data was going in/out of each component.
